Hi Alex,
Thanks for the update. We have noted 800 B750 bottles: 600 matte black and 200 matte white, with laser engraving and plain white individual boxes. We are preparing the FOB Ningbo quotation on this basis.
Please send the approved vector logo artwork when available. We are checking production timing; September 30 remains your requested arrival date and has not yet been confirmed. As your forwarder will arrange the sea freight, the transit schedule will also need to be checked with them.
Best regards,
Zhou Ning
